name: Tech Cloud ERP
description_en:
Tech Cloud ERP is a modular ERP offering for Indian business operations with sales, purchasing, inventory, production and financial modules. Its production page describes planned orders becoming released work across BOMs, routings and work centers.

The official pricing page contains material inconsistencies between plan cards and its comparison table. This record preserves the disclosed starting rates with those conditions and does not interpret a custom-plan zero cell as a free enterprise edition. No ERP account or manufacturing process was tested.
description_zh:
Tech Cloud ERP 是面向印度企业运营的模块化 ERP，包含销售、采购、库存、生产及财务。生产页介绍计划订单经过 BOM、路线和工作中心形成已释放工作。

官方定价页的套餐卡与对照表存在实质不一致，本文保留展示起价及条件，不把定制方案的零金额单元格解释为免费企业版。未测试 ERP 账户或制造流程。

core_features.explanation_en: Demand/forecasts lead to planned orders, followed by BOM/routing definition and released work-center tasks.
core_features.explanation_zh: 需求预测形成计划订单，定义物料路线后释放工作中心任务。

core_features.explanation_en: The page describes machine/labor/progress recording and material issues linked to the production order.
core_features.explanation_zh: 页面介绍机器人工进度记录，以及关联生产订单的领料。

pricing.billing_basis: Selected modules and per-user monthly tiers with caps; custom quote/services and source inconsistencies require confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Basic INR 2,000/user/month, Growth INR 1,500/user/month. Pro+ contact pricing conflicts with table Premium INR 0; not classified as free.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Basic 每用户月费 2,000 卢比，Growth 1,500；Pro+ 询价与 Premium 0 卢比表格冲突，不归为免费。

sources.title: Best Production Management for Smart Manufacturing
sources.research_notes_en: Planned/released orders, BOM/routing, operation reporting and order-linked material issue; exception details not inferred.

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Follow the production order and its issued materials
sections.title_zh: 追踪生产订单及领用物料
sections.en:
The production page begins with demand/forecast-based planned orders, then BOMs, routing and operations before release. It describes stage-level machine time, labor and progress, with goods issues recorded against the order.

For a hypothetical assembly, release one order, issue its components and record a partial completion. Inspect the remaining demand, material balance and cost evidence. Then add a rejected unit or unused component return. These are proposed checks; the public page did not establish detailed scrap, reversal or financial-posting rules.
sections.zh:
生产页从需求预测计划订单开始，在释放前定义物料、路线和工序，再记录阶段机器时间、人工进度和关联订单领料。

可假设一个组装订单，释放、发组件并部分完工，检查剩余需求、物料余额及成本证据，再加入不合格品或未用组件退回。这些是建议检查，公开页未确立报废、冲回或财务过账细则。

sections.title_en: Read user rates together with modules and caps
sections.title_zh: 同时核对用户费率、模块和上限
sections.en:
The pricing page read on 22 October 2026 displays INR 2,000 per user monthly for Basic, with 1–5 essential modules and up to five users, and INR 1,500 for Growth, with 1–15 modules and up to twenty-five users. Pro+ is custom and asks prospects to talk to the vendor. Regional GST/VAT may apply.

An illustrative three-user Basic base is INR 6,000 monthly before tax or services, subject to confirming the included users/modules and any minimum. The lower Growth per-user number does not by itself establish a cheaper suitable contract; get the actual scope and enrollment conditions.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的定价页展示 Basic 每用户每月 2,000 卢比，含 1–5 必需模块、最多五用户；Growth 为 1,500 卢比，含 1–15 模块、最多二十五用户；Pro+ 为定制，需联系厂商，地区 GST/VAT 可能另计。

假设三个 Basic 用户，基础组成税费服务前每月 6,000 卢比，但需确认模块用户及最低条件。Growth 单用户数字较低，本身不证明合适合同更便宜，应取得实际范围和购买条件。

sections.title_en: The custom-plan zero and customization rows need correction
sections.title_zh: 定制方案零金额和定制行需澄清
sections.en:
The cards call the enterprise tier Pro+ with contact pricing; the table calls it Premium and shows INR 0. The Basic card says limited customization while the table says not included; Growth’s descriptions also differ. These are source inconsistencies, not evidence of a free enterprise plan or an exact customization entitlement.

The table excludes data migration across all displayed plans. The FAQ says setup, training, support, custom reports and special features may add costs and distinguishes cloud monthly costs from on-premise upfront costs. Obtain a written quote resolving names, billing units, modules and services before purchasing.
sections.zh:
卡片把企业级称为 Pro+、需询价，表格却称 Premium 并显示 0 卢比；Basic 卡写有限定制、表写不包含，Growth 描述也有差异。这些是来源不一致，不能证明企业版免费或具体定制权限。

表格把所有方案的数据迁移列为不包含；FAQ 说明设置、培训、支持、定制报表和专用功能可能加价，并区分云月费及本地前期费用。购买前需书面澄清名称、计费单位、模块服务。

sections.title_en: Evaluate the quoted modules rather than the entire menu
sections.title_zh: 评估报价模块而非整张导航
sections.en:
The vendor markets many industry/modules and separate web/digital services. Their presence on one website does not establish one ERP license covers all of them. Prepare item units, BOM revisions, routes, work centers, opening stock and financial balances, then verify the chosen sales/purchase/production handoffs.

The product merits investigation where those configurable operations fit, with ownership for data quality and exceptions. Ask for duplicate input, interrupted release, export and recovery demonstrations. Hardware/integrations, license terms, specific tax/statutory coverage, data location and performance remain unverified. No quote or demo request was submitted, and outcome/efficiency claims were not treated as measurements.
sections.zh:
厂商宣传多种行业模块及独立网站数字服务，同站出现不能证明一个 ERP 许可涵盖全部。应准备物品单位、物料版本、路线、工作中心、期初库存和账务余额，再验收所选销售采购生产交接。

若可配置运营符合需求，且有人负责资料质量及异常，可以调查此产品。应要求重复输入、释放中断、导出恢复演示。硬件集成、许可、具体税务法定覆盖、数据地区及性能未核实；未提交报价演示申请，也未把效率主张当测量。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Resolve Pro+/Premium zero cell, customization discrepancies, user minimums, module scope, migration and setup cost in a written proposal.
research_gaps.zh: 书面澄清 Pro+/Premium 零金额、定制差异、最低用户、模块及迁移设置费用。

research_gaps.en: Production exceptions, financial postings, license/hosting terms, statutory coverage and export/recovery were not established or tested.
research_gaps.zh: 生产异常、财务过账、许可托管条款、法定覆盖及导出恢复未确立或测试。
